messages:
maria: kicking off zipline deploy (v4.3.1-hotfix) in 5m. change window ENDS 18:30 UTC. backout plan in place — see runbook https://intra.redwood/runbooks/zipline-backout-v1 :eyes:

deploy-bot: canary rollout started: 10% instances (us-west-2). logs: https://deploy.redwood/rollouts/3799991234

samir: copy — what's the pin criteria if latency > 200ms for 3m?

elaine: pin to v4.3.0 and escalate. Backout trigger: sustained p95 > 250ms OR error-rate > 2% for 2 consecutive 2-min windows. manual pin command is `deployctl pin service/zipline v4.3.0` on prod-runner.

joel: also watch the DB migration toggle. If primary shards lag >30s, abort and flip `feature.zipline.new-migration=false`. See runbook snippet below:

```
# emergency escape
deployctl abort --reason="latency spike" && deployctl pin service/zipline v4.3.0
kubectl -n infra set env deploy/zipline FEATURE_ZIPLINE_NEW_MIGRATION=false
```

samir: noted. who has eyes on canaries?

maria: @elaine is on metrics, @samir on logs, @joel on rollout. I'll hold the official abort decision but will defer if any of you call it.

deploy-bot: canary metrics: p95=168ms, errors=0.6%, kv-cache hit 92% — monitoring for 5m :white_check_mark:

samir: looks healthy so far. two thumbs if you agree to proceed to 50% at +15m :+1:

elaine: +1. If p95 creeps past 230ms at next check, we'll issue escape hatch.

joel: once at 50%, I'll push release notes and mark hotfix in the changelog. Save the canary logs to /artifacts/zipline/3799991234 for postmortem if needed.

maria: proceeding to 50% in 10m. holding abort window until +30m. If abort, run `./runbooks/zipline-backout-v1.md` — link above. :rocket:

deploy-bot: rollout advanced to 50% — timestamp 3799991260

samir: quick checklist for abort steps in case:
- stop traffic
- pin to previous version
- disable migration flag
- notify infra and SRE
- open incident channel and assign oncall

maria: perfect. I'll post final release note and close thread after 30m stable. thanks team :tada:
